why: An image dropped into an image grid gets a finite itrf: addImage stores two numbers per cell, which is how the grid reads them. The .fixed outputs differ from the old ones only there: special/image-grid stores off as [o, o] instead of [[o, o]], image/grid-images has the itrf translation 1.5714285714285705 instead of NaN (the old app computes the same value when its offsets are written flat), and image/paint-grid draws the image that the NaN transform left out.
